claim.quote: Therefore, we have measured the K-series x rays of kaonic hydrogen atoms at the DAΦNE electron-positron collider of Laboratori Nazionali di Frascati, and have determined the most precise values of the strong-interaction energy-level shift and width of the 1s atomic state.

date.locator: arXiv abstract page, submission date (arXiv:1105.3090 v1)
date.note: arXiv submission date; published in Phys. Lett. B 704 (2011) 113.

key_value_text.quote: The shift and width were determined to be ǫ1s = −283 ± 36(stat) ± 6(syst) eV and Γ1s = 541 ± 89(stat) ± 22(syst) eV, respectively.
key_value_text.value: Kaonic hydrogen 1s shift ε = −283 ± 36 (stat) ± 6 (syst) eV and width Γ = 541 ± 89 (stat) ± 22 (syst) eV

name: A New Measurement of Kaonic Hydrogen X rays

summary.plain: SIDDHARTA measured X-rays from kaonic hydrogen with fast silicon drift detectors and obtained the most precise values of how the strong force shifts and broadens the atom's ground state, a key input for low-energy models of the antikaon-nucleon force.
summary.technical: SIDDHARTA at DAΦNE (2009 data): kaonic hydrogen K-series X-rays with large-area silicon drift detectors; 1s strong-interaction shift ε = −283 ± 36 (stat) ± 6 (syst) eV and width Γ = 541 ± 89 (stat) ± 22 (syst) eV (Phys. Lett. B 704 (2011) 113).

title: A New Measurement of Kaonic Hydrogen X rays
why_it_matters: The abstract describes the shift and width as the most precise values determined and says they provide vital constraints on the theoretical description of the low-energy antikaon-nucleon interaction.
